items.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
items.summary: OpenAI shares model results on the Kakeya conjecture, Exponential Time Hypothesis, and quantum chromodynamics—and how researchers can verify and build on them.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
items.summary: CodeRabbit uses GPT-6.1 Sol to investigate security risks across complex codebases. Its security agent helps developers review findings and proposed fixes.

items.title: ChatGPT’s expanding world of work
items.summary: Explore OpenAI Signals data on 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how people use ChatGPT for work and how usage changes over time.

items.title: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
items.summary: Fanatics uses OpenAI to help fans complete their game-day outfits with Shop the Look. Testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products showed 10% higher engagement.

items.title: How Ultrafast cut incident investigation from hours to minutes at OpenAI
items.summary: See how OpenAI engineers use Codex Ultrafast to investigate incidents in minutes. Explore faster security analysis, code refactoring, and daily workflows.

items.title: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
items.summary: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half.

items.title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
items.summary: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world.

items.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI scaled Habitat with reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver 12× faster reads for ChatGPT.

items.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
items.summary: OpenAI explains how we strengthened containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.

items.title: Anima helps clinics cut call waits by 75% with GPT-6 and GPT-Live
items.summary: Anima expands what care teams can do with OpenAI models, giving them more capacity to respond to patients.

items.summary: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK are partnering on AI safety, security, and technical research to strengthen safeguards and support a more resilient digital ecosystem.

items.summary: AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is a new security service that uses AI to automatically find, validate, and prioritize code vulnerabilities in your environment, then delivers ready-to-review fixes as pull requests replacing what previously took hours of manual investigation and days of cross-team coordination.

items.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API

items.summary: As Cybersecurity Awareness Month continues, the GitHub Bug Bounty team spotlights @r31n, diving into their research approach, favorite bug classes, and advice for aspiring hackers. The post How bug bounty sharpens one researcher’s security skills appeared first on The GitHub Blog .

items.title: Localizing compliance at scale: Achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
items.summary: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program.

items.summary: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.

The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure
items.summary: We moved a copy of 99.99999% of GitHub's repositories to Azure. Here's how per-reference quorums will bring over the rest, and how object storage lets reads scale independently. The post The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure appeared first on The GitHub Blog .

items.title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
items.summary: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. Full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations that request-only inspection can miss.

items.title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
items.summary: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure. The rules use request and response signals to stop exploit attempts and prevent exposed data from reaching attackers.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
items.summary: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.

items.title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents
items.summary: Almost 100,000 Commerce.com domains now give AI agents real shopping tools through WebMCP on Cloudflare. Here's how we turned it on across every store at once, while keeping each merchant in control.

items.summary: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.
